tables.qwen_temporal_mps100: one canonical set of raw runs referenced by both tables, no historical override

sampling.repeat_process: fresh process with loaded model, no dummy inference or explicit inference warmup
sampling.selection: fixed first 200 TEST sample IDs in sealed order; same IDs across models and repeats where defined
sampling.short_test_exception: APPROVED: ABO text-query TEST has 100 distinct queries, two complete passes per repeat for200 timed calls, quality denominator100 unique queries
sampling.performance: preserve full-TEST reference metric separately; recompute measured-subset metric from predictions and label its denominator
sampling.first_sample: retained; later calls naturally warm; not 200 independent cold starts
sampling.no_optimization_changes: retain original frame selection, processor, dtype, precision, graph, checkpoint, heads, search and output semantics

e2e.proposed_input_boundary: before reading the sample image/video file or receiving its UTF-8 text; decode, sampling, processor, CPU tokenizer, H2D, embeddings and output conversion included
e2e.output_boundary: task result is ready to the caller: CPU score, retrieval result, keypoints, saliency map, edited output or generated image as defined for that task
e2e.gallery: same online-query boundary for both; fixed gallery preparation separately recorded, never hidden per-query recomputation
e2e.cache: record actual OS cache and loader state; no selective flush, forced cache warming or differing caches chosen to improve a ratio
e2e.diagnostics: APPROVED: synchronized wall is primary for baseline and LightGen included neural stages; paired CUDA Events retained for the difference, no selection of minimum or faster statistic after seeing results
e2e.logging: buffer timestamps and predictions, export after window; existing genuine request gaps retained; do not add sleeps or flush Excel in each request

scope_separation.software_e2e: actual full simulation wall includes FFT simulation; diagnostic only, not physical optical inference time
scope_separation.physical_e2e: requires actual device input/control/readout timestamps; do not claim measured E2E without them
scope_separation.hardware_projection: replace only optical numerical propagation by confirmed hardware pass time; retain all required frontend, neural and serial handling stages; mark any unmeasured interval missing, not zero

lightgen.parallel_residual: APPROVED accounting: record separately, exclude its time/energy from charged optical projection; retain executed operations separately. This is not a claim that all residuals have physically demonstrated complete overlap.
lightgen.fusion_layout: GPU NN-only subtotal excludes pure layout/fusion by request; actual required elapsed time is still retained separately in E2E or explicitly missing in projection
lightgen.200_video_tail: 13 physical fields, last field 8 valid videos plus 8 padding; full field cost charged, padding excluded from predictions and sample denominator
lightgen.batch_one_choice_pending: APPROVED: retain original sixteen-video full coherent physical field; batch1 refers to one field for LightGen and one video for electronic baselines; final per-frame is explicitly amortized equivalent

optical.basis: user and device technician confirmed timing parameters, not a new wall-clock device measurement; exact manual page not yet bound

lightgen.online_query_pass_exception: ABO .8600 text-to-image retrieval title query uses three language passes; gallery image uses six passes offline

units.equivalent_frame: video cost divided by actual sampled frame count, four for LGVQ; an amortized equivalent, not independent frame-task latency
units.image: one image query or output is one sample/frame-equivalent with scope labeled
units.text_only_query: one query as the native unit; any one-image-equivalent convention explicitly labeled, not a physical input frame
units.headline: no sixteen-video multiplication; retain original workload fields and single-video results in source data

energy.board_mean: integral(P_board(t), window)/T_window, not unweighted mean of per-call means
energy.proposed_extended_phase_model: NOT ADOPTED; user reaffirmed optical/electronic phase-only model, no full-window always-on energy
energy.full_window_all_on_sensitivity: (80.358+41.388+62.842)*T_projected_e2e = 184.588*T_projected_e2e; optional estimate, not an actual whole-system power trace
energy.pending: APPROVED primary LightGen energy =121.746*t_optical +104.230*t_charged_electronic, seconds; label phase-accounted system-energy estimate, not a full-window wall-plug integral; exclude parallel-residual and layout intervals from charged subtotal as directed
energy.chassis_assumption: 338.2 W excludes the separately added GPU contribution; verify meter coverage to avoid double counting

operations_and_tokens.mac: 1 real MAC = 2 OP; Linear MAC = batch*tokens*in_features*out_features; Conv MAC = batch*out_h*out_w*out_channels*(in_channels/groups)*kernel_h*kernel_w
operations_and_tokens.count_scope: actual per-sample shapes, actual executed branches, frontends and task head in same cost boundary; op profile in a separate untimed replay
operations_and_tokens.non_mac: explicit rule and unsupported-op list for activations, norms, softmax, embeddings and indexing; no parameter-count shortcut or invented zero-cost timing
operations_and_tokens.parallel_residual_ops: retain total executed NN OP and charged-serial OP as separate fields; do not silently remove real executed work from the total
operations_and_tokens.optical_equivalent: report equivalent dense propagation OP separately from actual GPU numerical-simulation FFT OP; do not count both as physical work
operations_and_tokens.common_tokens: same sample-level Qwen reference input count for LightGen and Qwen, valid nonpadding full input sequence when available; actual masks/shapes stored for all200
operations_and_tokens.ratio_check: LightGen/Qwen common Tokens/s ratio equals Qwen/LightGen duration ratio for same sample workload
operations_and_tokens.missing_counts: missing, never substitute max sequence or one sample's length; no comparison of native internal token rates as a time speedup

quality_gates: exact full checkpoint and runtime source SHA verified
test manifest and all dimensions locked
GPU UUID and cap independently verified
no foreign compute during charged window
interval union and energy integral agree
one canonical Qwen temporal MPS100 record in both tables
approved_scope_label: Input-inclusive hybrid hardware projection: measured input/frontend and selected NN stages plus parameter-derived optical cycles; intermediate layout and parallel residual excluded, not fully measured device operational E2E. Baseline is file-to-CPU-result continuous measured wall.
task_stage_ledger_required: For every task retain included module/method names, source SHA and lines, stage family, calls, tensor dimensions, excluded layout/residual/FFT and observed versus expected bridge occurrences.

baseline_large_gpu.status: A100 80GB rental pending user action after other preparations
baseline_large_gpu.hardware_comparability: log PCIe/SXM, power cap, software and actual UUID; run a Qwen anchor on rental if direct across-GPU model comparisons are required

baseline_identity_gate: Every baseline full checkpoint/source SHA must be bound before measurements; displayed performance values alone are not identity proof.
